mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teamup (id, type, title, leader, start_time,leader_name,people_number) VALUES (#{id},#{type},#{title},#{leader},#{startTime},#{leaderName},#{peopleNumber})

INSERT INTO comment_teamup(teamup_id, parent_id, text, picture, son, create_time, user_id, reply_user_id) VALUES (#{teamupId}, #{parentId}, #{text}, #{picture}, #{son}, #{createTime}, #{userId}, #{replyUserId})

INSERT INTO comment_circle(circle_id, parent_id, text, picture, son, create_time, user_id, reply_user_id) VALUES (#{circleId}, #{parentId}, #{text}, #{picture}, #{son}, #{createTime}, #{userId}, #{replyUserId})
INSERT IGNORE INTO circle_like (user_id, circle_id) VALUES (#{currentUserId},#{circleId})
INSERT IGNORE INTO activity_like (user_id, activity_id) VALUES (#{currentUserId},#{activityId})

SELECT t.id, t.type, t.title, t.leader, t.start_time, t.create_at, t.update_at, t.leader_name, t.people_number FROM teamup t JOIN team_up_participate tp ON t.id = tp.teamUpId WHERE tp.userId = #{userId}
SELECT id, type, title, leader, start_time, create_at, update_at, leader_name FROM teamup WHERE leader=#{currentUserId}

SELECT t.id, t.type, t.title, t.leader, t.start_time, t.create_at, t.leader_name, t.people_number, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_up_participate tp WHERE tp.teamUpId = t.id) AS participateNumber, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_up_participate WHERE userId =#{userId} AND teamUpId=#{id}) as joined FROM teamup t WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT parent_id FROM comment_teamup WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT id, user_id, type, content, create_time, update_time, category, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circle_like WHERE circle_id = #{id}) like_number, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circle_like WHERE circle_id = #{id} AND user_id = #{currentUserId}) is_like FROM circle WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, user_id, type, bounty, request_content, note, create_time, category, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accept_task WHERE circleId = #{id}) as total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circle_like WHERE user_id = #{currentUserId} AND circle_id = #{id}) AS is_like, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circle_like WHERE circle_id = #{id}) AS like_number FROM circle WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, user_id, type, title, picture, start_time, end_time, create_time, category, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_join WHERE activityId = #{id} AND userId = #{currentUserId}) AS participant, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_join WHERE activityId = #{id}) AS NumberOfParticipants, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circle_like WHERE circle_id = #{id}) AS like_number, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circle_like WHERE circle_id = #{id} AND user_id = #{currentUserId}) AS is_like FROM circle WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, user_id, type, content, bounty, request_content, note, title, picture, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time, category FROM circle WHERE id IN (SELECT circle_id FROM join_circle WHERE user_id = #{currentUserId})

SELECT c.id, c.type, c.bounty, c.request_content, c.note, c.user_id, c.create_time FROM circle c INNER JOIN accept_task at ON c.id = at.circleId WHERE at.userId = #{currentUserId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.title, c.picture, c.start_time, c.end_time, c.create_time FROM circle c INNER JOIN activity_join aj ON c.id = aj.activityId WHERE aj.userId = #{currentUserId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
